analysis: The PR changes only the test file provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/MiMo/MiMoV26ManagedAudioProviderTests.swift. In two DEBUG-gated opt-in tests it replaces a polling loop for media-reservation settlement (base lines 270-277) with a deterministic hook. The new code calls value.transaction.setMediaReservationRemovalHookForTesting at head lines 245-247 and 306-307, counts events with EventCounter, and waits via await fulfillment(of:[settled],timeout:10) at head lines 274 and 346. The assertions on managedMediaReservationCountForTesting == 0 and on a zero processLedger chargedBytes remain after the wait (head lines 277, 281, 354, 359). No production code, wire protocol, key handling, attestation, authorization or prefix-cache storage (T-041) path is touched. The test builds use synthetic audio, and a local server bound to 127.0.0.1 with a test token that exists only inside the DEBUG test. No new attack surface, secrets, or weakened production controls were found. Remaining unverified items: the definitions of the test-only hook and EventCounter are not in the supplied evidence. If the hook is compiled outside DEBUG or is not gated behind test-only compilation, it could affect production, but that cannot be assessed from this diff. The truncated patch excerpt past head line 307 matches the full head text shown, so no hidden changes were identified.
